Dies betrifft insbesondere Verträge über Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Beherbergung zu anderen Zwecken als zu Wohnzwecken, Kraftfahrzeugvermietung sowie bestimmte weitere Dienstleistungen im Zusammenhang mit Freizeitbetätigungen, wenn für die Leistung ein spezifischer Termin oder Zeitraum vorgesehen ist. Datenschutzrechtliche Einwilligung

Im Rahmen meiner Anfrage bei MedLuxLife, Inh. Anna Sacilanates (Einzelunternehmen), Stolberger Straße 21, 52068 Aachen, Deutschland, kann es erforderlich sein, personenbezogene Daten und insbesondere Gesundheitsdaten zu verarbeiten und an die für meine Anfrage ausgewählten medizinischen Leistungserbringer zu übermitteln.

Hierzu können insbesondere folgende Daten gehören:

  • Vor- und Nachname sowie Kontaktdaten
  • Angaben zur gewünschten Behandlung
  • Angaben zum Gesundheitszustand und zu Vorerkrankungen
  • medizinische Befunde und Arztberichte
  • Röntgenbilder und sonstige medizinische Aufnahmen
  • Fotos, soweit diese für die Beurteilung der gewünschten Behandlung erforderlich sind
  • sonstige von mir zur medizinischen Beurteilung bereitgestellte Informationen und Unterlagen

Zweck der Verarbeitung

Die Verarbeitung und Übermittlung erfolgt ausschließlich, soweit dies zur Bearbeitung meiner Anfrage erforderlich ist, insbesondere zur:

  • medizinischen Vorprüfung meiner Anfrage,
  • Einholung einer medizinischen Einschätzung,
  • Erstellung eines Behandlungs- bzw. Kostenvorschlags,
  • Auswahl und Abstimmung mit einer geeigneten Partnerklinik bzw. behandelnden Ärztinnen und Ärzten,
  • Organisation und Koordination von Behandlungsterminen,
  • Vorbereitung der von mir gewünschten medizinischen Behandlung.

Ausdrückliche Einwilligung in die Verarbeitung von Gesundheitsdaten

Gesundheitsdaten gehören zu den besonderen Kategorien personenbezogener Daten im Sinne von Art. 9 DSGVO.

Ich willige ausdrücklich gemäß Art. 9 Abs. 2 lit. a DSGVO ein, dass MedLuxLife die von mir bereitgestellten Gesundheitsdaten für die oben genannten Zwecke verarbeitet.

Übermittlung in die Türkei

Mir ist bekannt, dass die für meine Anfrage ausgewählte Partnerklinik, behandelnde Ärztin bzw. der behandelnde Arzt oder ein anderer medizinischer Leistungserbringer seinen Sitz in der Türkei haben kann.

Soweit dies für die Bearbeitung meiner Anfrage und die Vorbereitung der von mir gewünschten Behandlung erforderlich ist, willige ich ausdrücklich ein, dass MedLuxLife die hierfür erforderlichen personenbezogenen Daten einschließlich meiner Gesundheitsdaten an den jeweiligen medizinischen Leistungserbringer in der Türkei übermittelt.

Ich willige ausdrücklich gemäß Art. 49 Abs. 1 lit. a DSGVO in diese Drittlandübermittlung ein.

Hinweis auf mögliche Risiken der Drittlandübermittlung

Ich wurde darüber informiert, dass die Türkei ein Drittland außerhalb der Europäischen Union und des Europäischen Wirtschaftsraums ist und für die Türkei derzeit kein Angemessenheitsbeschluss der Europäischen Kommission besteht.

Mir ist insbesondere bekannt, dass bei einer Übermittlung in ein Drittland ohne Angemessenheitsbeschluss und ohne geeignete Garantien möglicherweise kein mit dem Datenschutzrecht der Europäischen Union vergleichbares Datenschutzniveau gewährleistet ist. Dies kann insbesondere bedeuten, dass:

  • meine personenbezogenen Daten einem anderen gesetzlichen Datenschutzniveau unterliegen,
  • staatliche Stellen unter den dort geltenden gesetzlichen Voraussetzungen Zugriff auf Daten erhalten können,
  • meine datenschutzrechtlichen Betroffenenrechte möglicherweise schwieriger durchsetzbar sind,
  • mir gegebenenfalls nicht dieselben Rechtsbehelfe und Durchsetzungsmöglichkeiten wie innerhalb der EU bzw. des EWR zur Verfügung stehen.

Freiwilligkeit und Widerruf

Die Erteilung dieser Einwilligung ist freiwillig.

Ohne meine Einwilligung kann MedLuxLife meine Gesundheitsdaten nicht auf dieser Grundlage verarbeiten bzw. an einen medizinischen Leistungserbringer in der Türkei übermitteln. Dadurch kann eine medizinische Beurteilung, Angebotserstellung oder Organisation der gewünschten Behandlung gegebenenfalls nicht möglich sein.

Ich kann meine Einwilligung jederzeit mit Wirkung für die Zukunft widerrufen. Der Widerruf berührt nicht die Rechtmäßigkeit der Verarbeitung, die aufgrund meiner Einwilligung bis zum Zeitpunkt des Widerrufs erfolgt ist.

Der Widerruf kann insbesondere per E-Mail gerichtet werden an:

MedLuxLife
Inh. Anna Sacilanates
Stolberger Straße 21
52068 Aachen, Deutschland
E-Mail: info@medluxlife.de

Weitere Informationen zur Verarbeitung personenbezogener Daten und zu meinen Datenschutzrechten finde ich in der Datenschutzerklärung von MedLuxLife.

Intensive care provides round-the-clock treatment and monitoring for patients whose organs or organ systems are severely affected. The units at our partner hospital combine advanced monitoring technology with a multidisciplinary team. MedLuxLife keeps families informed, coordinates communication with the care team and assists with travel and accommodation for relatives.

Treatments and services

24-hour care and monitoring

Diagnosis, treatment and follow-up continue without interruption, with vital signs monitored continuously by advanced devices.

Multidisciplinary team

Physicians, nurses, physiotherapists, assistant physicians, dietitians and social workers specialised in intensive care work together.

Higher nurse-to-patient ratio

More nursing staff per patient than on a general ward, allowing closer observation.

Invasive monitoring

Intensive interventional monitoring of vital functions when a patient's condition requires it.

Mechanical ventilation

Breathing support for patients who cannot breathe adequately on their own.

Circulatory and kidney support

Vasopressor medicines to support blood pressure and continuous dialysis to support kidney function.

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Discharge summaries and intensive care reports from the referring hospital
  • A current medication list including infusions

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Intensive Care Unit consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Request a Free Consultation
WhatsApp

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.

Anaesthesiology and reanimation keeps patients comfortable and free from pain while carefully protecting vital functions during surgery and other procedures. The department at our partner hospital provides anaesthesia, intensive care and pain management, supporting safe treatment and a smoother recovery. MedLuxLife ensures your anaesthetic history and current medication are shared with the team before any planned procedure.

Treatments and services

Anaesthesia services

Anaesthesia for surgery and interventional procedures, delivered with modern equipment and continuous monitoring of vital signs.

Supervised recovery

Patients wake up in dedicated recovery areas within the operating suite under the close watch of a physician and an anaesthesia technician.

General intensive care unit

Specialist physicians and nurses care for critically ill adults using mechanical ventilators, cardiac and respiratory monitors, infusion pumps and bedside laboratory testing.

Cardiovascular surgery intensive care

A dedicated unit for patients recovering after heart and major vascular surgery.

Neonatal intensive care

Intensive care for newborn babies who need close monitoring and support.

Isolation rooms

Rooms with adjustable pressure, temperature and humidity for patients with weakened immunity, for example during sepsis or chemotherapy.

MedLuxLife can help you understand how this field relates to your care and connect you with the appropriate clinical specialists.

Treatments and services

Histology

Study of development from fertilisation to birth.

The transfusion centre supports inpatients and other patients who need blood component therapy, cellular therapy, therapeutic apheresis or specialised laboratory diagnostics. MedLuxLife coordinates these services at our partner hospital as part of your wider treatment plan.

Treatments and services

Blood component therapy

Safe and appropriate administration of blood products for patients who need them during treatment.

Cellular therapy

Collection and preparation of cellular therapy products used in patient care.

Therapeutic apheresis

Procedures that separate and remove or replace specific blood components as part of treatment.

Specialised laboratory diagnostics

Diagnostic and compatibility testing to support safe transfusion.

Blood bank

Provides packed red blood cells, fresh frozen plasma and platelets.

Research and training

Support for clinical research and advanced training in transfusion medicine and related technologies.

Blood bank products

  • Packed red blood cells

  • Platelets

Round-the-clock care for adult and paediatric patients with acute illness or injury, led by emergency medicine specialists.

A room set up for the assessment and initial treatment of injured patients.

Medical pathology examines tissue and cell samples to establish a diagnosis and guide treatment, with an emphasis on fast and accurate reporting. The department at our partner hospital includes immunohistochemistry and cytopathology laboratories and works with the microbiology and genetics laboratories for advanced methods. MedLuxLife coordinates the practical steps, including the transfer of existing samples and the translation of reports.

Treatments and services

Intraoperative frozen section

Rapid assessment of suspicious tissue during surgery, available at any time of day, to support decisions in the operating theatre.

Biopsy reporting

Biopsy samples are reported within a few working days, depending on their nature.

Rapid processing for urgent cases

Accelerated processing when cancer is suspected or urgent treatment is needed, so a preliminary diagnosis can be reached without delay.

Histochemistry and immunohistochemistry

Staining panels, manual or automated, that help determine tumour origin, classification, proliferation index and prognostic markers.

Immunohistochemistry laboratory

Diagnostic histochemical and immunohistochemical staining and immunofluorescence studies, with daily automated processing.

Advanced molecular methods

PCR, flow cytometry and in situ hybridisation carried out jointly with the microbiology and genetics laboratories.

Cytopathology

Liquid-based and conventional cytology, with immunocytochemistry when needed.

On-site sample adequacy assessment

Pathologists check sample adequacy on site while interventional teams take diagnostic samples.

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Original pathology reports
  • Paraffin blocks and slides for review, if a second opinion is requested

Medical microbiology provides the laboratory testing behind the diagnosis and treatment of infections. The laboratories at our partner hospital support inpatient, outpatient and emergency care across bacteriology, virology, parasitology, mycology, molecular microbiology and infection immunology, with a broad and regularly updated test panel. MedLuxLife coordinates sample collection during your visit and ensures your results are translated and shared with your doctors.

Treatments and services

Bacteriology

Identification of bacteria and antibiotic susceptibility testing, combining classical culture with rapid confirmatory methods and same-day stained microscopy.

Mycobacteriology (tuberculosis)

Isolation and identification of acid-fast organisms such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis and Mycobacterium avium complex, including molecular methods and the Quantiferon TB Gold test.

Virology

Antigen and antibody serology, sensitive detection of HIV and hepatitis agents, and confirmatory testing where needed.

Parasitology

Diagnosis of parasitic infections using classical methods supported by serological tests.

Mycology

Identification of yeasts, dermatophytes and moulds, plus galactomannan antigen testing for suspected aspergillus infection in immunocompromised patients.

Molecular microbiology

PCR-based detection, genotyping and viral load testing, including viruses monitored after transplantation.

Syndromic molecular panels

Rapid multiplex testing of blood cultures, respiratory, gastrointestinal, cerebrospinal and joint fluid samples, with simultaneous detection of resistance genes.

Infection immunology

Immunological tests that support the diagnosis of infectious diseases.

Round-the-clock service

The laboratory operates 24 hours a day and works closely with clinicians on diagnosis and treatment.

Selected tests

  • Bacterial culture and antibiotic susceptibility testing
  • Stained microscopy of clinical samples
  • Acid-fast bacteria staining
  • Quantiferon TB Gold
  • Galactomannan antigen test
  • Hepatitis B virus DNA
  • Hepatitis C virus RNA
  • Varicella zoster virus (VZV)
  • Epstein-Barr virus (EBV DNA)
  • Cytomegalovirus (CMV DNA)
  • Polyomavirus (BK/JC virus)
  • Human papillomavirus (HPV DNA) and genotyping
  • Viral load tests
  • MRSA (real-time PCR)
  • VRE (real-time PCR)
  • Neisseria gonorrhoeae (real-time PCR)
  • Chlamydia (real-time PCR)
  • Syndromic panels for blood culture, respiratory, gastrointestinal, CSF and joint fluid samples
  • Resistance gene detection

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Previous culture, serology or PCR results
  • A list of recent antibiotic treatments

Medical imaging underpins the diagnosis and treatment planning of many conditions. The imaging unit at our partner hospital brings together radiology and nuclear medicine specialists with a broad range of modern equipment and fully digital reporting. MedLuxLife schedules your examinations, shares preparation instructions in advance and makes sure your images and reports reach you and your doctors at home.

Treatments and services

MRI and functional MRI

3 Tesla MRI, including functional MRI to map vital brain areas before tumour surgery, and MR proton and phosphorus spectroscopy to characterise tumours.

PET/CT

Shows the metabolic activity of tumours and helps determine their location, and can be used to monitor response to treatment.

Nuclear medicine and SPECT

Gamma camera and SPECT imaging, reported by nuclear medicine specialists.

CT, X-ray and fluoroscopy

Multi-slice CT, digital direct radiography, digital fluoroscopy, portable X-ray and C-arm imaging.

Breast and bone imaging

Digital mammography and bone densitometry for breast assessment and bone health.

Ultrasound

4D ultrasonography and Doppler ultrasonography for organ and blood flow assessment.

Molecular imaging

Techniques that add functional and metabolic information to anatomical images, which may help classify tumours and in some cases reduce the need for biopsy.

Interventional radiology

Minimally invasive, image-guided treatments carried out in the dedicated interventional radiology unit, using flat panel digital angiography (DSA).

Digital archiving (PACS and RIS)

All images and reports are stored digitally, shared across the hospital and can be exchanged with imaging centres abroad.

Research

A university setting with ongoing research, including the development of a molecular imaging research unit.

Preparation forms

Before your examination you may be asked to complete a patient information form, an MRI preparation form and a pregnancy information and consent form for radiological examinations.

Imaging equipment

  • 3 Tesla Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI)
  • Multi-slice Computed Tomography (MD-CT)
  • PET/CT

MedLuxLife schedules your examinations, shares preparation instructions in advance and makes sure your images and reports reach you and your doctors at home.

Treatments and services

MRI and functional MRI

3 Tesla MRI, including functional MRI to map vital brain areas before tumour surgery, and MR proton and phosphorus spectroscopy to characterise tumours.

PET/CT

Shows the metabolic activity of tumours and helps determine their location, and can be used to monitor response to treatment.

Nuclear medicine and SPECT

Gamma camera and SPECT imaging, reported by nuclear medicine specialists.

CT, X-ray and fluoroscopy

Multi-slice CT, digital direct radiography, digital fluoroscopy, portable X-ray and C-arm imaging.

Breast and bone imaging

Digital mammography and bone densitometry for breast assessment and bone health.

Ultrasound

4D ultrasonography and Doppler ultrasonography for organ and blood flow assessment.

Molecular imaging

Techniques that add functional and metabolic information to anatomical images, which may help classify tumours and in some cases reduce the need for biopsy.

Interventional radiology

Minimally invasive, image-guided treatments carried out in the dedicated interventional radiology unit, using flat panel digital angiography (DSA).

Research

A university setting with ongoing research, including the development of a molecular imaging research unit.

Medical genetics diagnoses inherited and non-inherited conditions caused by changes in genes, and helps individuals and families understand their risks, including carrier status and risks for future children. The genetic diagnosis centre at our partner hospital offers genetic consultations and counselling alongside cytogenetic, molecular cytogenetic and molecular genetic testing in ISO 15189 accredited laboratories. MedLuxLife coordinates appointments, sample logistics and translation of reports.

Treatments and services

Genetic consultation

Outpatient examination by a medical geneticist to assess whether a genetic condition may be present.

Genetic counselling

Explanation of results, risk assessment for relatives and future generations, and planning of preventive options, also for families referred from other centres.

Prenatal genetic diagnosis

Testing during pregnancy when screening suggests increased risk, with advanced maternal age, or when a parent carries a known genetic condition.

Postnatal genetic diagnosis

Testing in children and adults when a genetic cause is suspected, including recurrent miscarriage, infertility and hereditary neurological or muscle diseases.

Cytogenetics

Karyotype analysis on blood, amniotic fluid, chorionic villus, fetal blood and bone marrow samples.

Molecular cytogenetics

FISH testing, including rapid detection of common chromosomal changes and microdeletion syndromes, and molecular karyotyping (array CGH).

Molecular genetic testing

DNA analyses for single-gene diseases and carrier status.

Oncology and haematology genetics

FISH and DNA analyses on tumour tissue and bone marrow, used as markers for disease course and possible response to chemotherapy.

Interdisciplinary cooperation

Close collaboration with paediatrics, obstetrics and gynaecology, internal medicine, neurology, neurosurgery and pathology.

Situations in which genetic testing may be considered

  • Increased risk of a chromosomal anomaly in pregnancy screening
  • Advanced maternal age
  • Known carrier status for a chromosomal or single-gene disease
  • Down syndrome (trisomy 21) and other common chromosomal anomalies - rapid FISH on amniocentesis samples
  • Rapid chromosomal analysis on chorionic villus biopsy samples
  • Karyotype and DNA analyses on fetal blood samples
  • Congenital anomalies
  • Growth, developmental and intellectual disabilities
  • Short stature
  • Global developmental delay
  • Recurrent miscarriage
  • Infertility
  • Single-gene diseases more common in consanguineous families
  • Hereditary neurological and muscle diseases appearing in adulthood
  • Suspected inherited predisposition to thrombosis
  • Oncology and haematology patients (tumour tissue and bone marrow analyses)

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Previous genetic test reports
  • A family medical history covering at least three generations

The neonatal intensive care unit looks after premature babies and term newborns who need close monitoring and specialised treatment in their first weeks of life. MedLuxLife helps families coordinate admission to the NICU at our partner hospital, arrange transfers and medical records, and keep in touch with the care team. We support parents with travel, accommodation and translation so they can focus on their baby.

Treatments and services

Care for premature babies

Close observation and treatment of babies born early, in a setting designed for their specific needs.

Care for unwell term newborns

Monitoring and treatment for full-term babies born with health problems that require intensive care.

Round-the-clock care

Treatment and nursing continue 24 hours a day, seven days a week, with changes in the baby's condition monitored continuously and recorded.

Specialised equipment

Incubators, open care beds, respiratory support devices, monitors, medication pumps, central gas and oxygen supply and uninterruptible power systems.

Dedicated neonatal team

Physicians and nurses specialised in neonatal intensive care look after each baby.

Multidisciplinary input

Doctors from other specialties are involved when needed to assess critical situations and adjust treatment.

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Birth and discharge summaries for the baby
  • Pregnancy and delivery records of the mother

The radiology department provides a broad range of diagnostic imaging, from MRI and CT to PET-CT, mammography and ultrasound, together with interventional radiology. Images are acquired digitally and stored with their reports in a central archive, making them available to treating teams across the hospital. MedLuxLife can schedule imaging at our partner hospital as part of a check-up or treatment plan and arrange for your images and reports to be shared with you.

Treatments and services

MRI

3 Tesla magnetic resonance imaging for detailed views of soft tissues, the brain, spine and joints.

CT

64-slice multi-slice computed tomography for fast cross-sectional imaging.

PET-CT

Combined functional and anatomical imaging, often used in cancer assessment.

Digital X-ray and portable X-ray

Conventional digital radiography, with portable units available for patients who cannot be moved.

Ultrasound

Ultrasonography including Doppler, 3D and 4D imaging.

Digital mammography

Breast imaging for screening and diagnosis.

Fluoroscopy and C-arm

Real-time X-ray imaging used for dynamic studies and to guide procedures.

Digital angiography

Imaging of blood vessels for diagnosis and to guide treatment.

Bone densitometry

Measurement of bone density to assess osteoporosis.

Interventional radiology

Many vascular diseases can be diagnosed and treated with image-guided, minimally invasive techniques, avoiding open surgery in suitable cases.

Digital archive (PACS and RIS)

Images and reports are stored centrally and shared securely with clinical teams, and can be exchanged with external centres.

Research laboratory

The department includes a research laboratory supporting work in medical imaging.

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports

  • A list of your current medications and any allergies

Paediatric rheumatology covers the assessment, diagnosis and treatment of inflammatory and rheumatic conditions in childhood, which can affect the joints, muscles, blood vessels and skin as well as other organ systems. Because these conditions often differ from their adult forms, care is planned with a multidisciplinary approach. MedLuxLife arranges consultations and follow-up at our partner hospital and supports families throughout their stay.

Treatments and services

Specialist assessment

Careful evaluation of joint, muscle, skin and systemic symptoms in children to reach a clear diagnosis.

Recurrent fever evaluation

Investigation of unexplained or recurring fevers, including possible autoinflammatory causes.

Inflammatory joint disease

Diagnosis and treatment planning for juvenile arthritis and related joint conditions.

Vasculitis and multisystem disease

Care for conditions that inflame blood vessels or affect several organs at once.

Multidisciplinary care

Collaboration with other paediatric specialties when a condition involves more than the musculoskeletal system.

Long-term follow-up

Ongoing monitoring to help control disease activity and support the child's quality of life.

Conditions treated

  • Growing pains
  • Unexplained and recurring fevers
  • Juvenile idiopathic arthritis
  • Juvenile scleroderma
  • Familial Mediterranean fever
  • Acute rheumatic conditions
  • Chronic rheumatic diseases
  • Behçet's disease
  • Kawasaki disease
  • Henoch-Schönlein purpura
  • Granulomatosis with polyangiitis (Wegener's granulomatosis)
  • Other autoinflammatory diseases
  • Other rheumatological diseases

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports

Childhood and adolescence are times of rapid physical, emotional and psychological change, and mental health concerns in these years need an assessment that takes development and family circumstances into account. The child and adolescent psychiatry department at our partner hospital offers assessment, follow-up and treatment programmes for emotional, behavioural and developmental difficulties. MedLuxLife helps families arrange consultations, share school and medical reports and plan follow-up across borders.

Treatments and services

Comprehensive assessment

Evaluation of a child's mental, emotional and behavioural health in the context of their developmental stage and environment.

Diagnosis and treatment planning

Structured diagnosis and an individual treatment plan for disorders arising in childhood and adolescence.

Family and relationship support

Attention to mother-baby-child relationships, sibling rivalry and parent-teenager conflict.

Long-term follow-up

Ongoing monitoring of mental development, including for children with chronic illnesses and their families.

Areas of care

  • Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)
  • Learning disabilities
  • Autism and related pervasive developmental disorders
  • Depression and anxiety disorders in children and adolescents
  • Feeding and sleeping problems in infancy and the preschool years
  • Mother-baby-child relationship problems
  • Toileting (bladder and bowel habit) problems
  • Tic disorders
  • Language and speech development problems
  • Childhood masturbation
  • Sibling rivalry
  • Adjustment and behavioural problems
  • Thumb sucking and nail biting
  • Intellectual disability and related behavioural problems
  • Adolescent problems and parent-teenager conflicts
  • Children and adolescents prone to violence
  • Mental health concerns in children and adolescents with chronic illnesses, and their families

This department diagnoses and treats allergic conditions in children and adolescents from birth to 18 years. A range of skin, blood, breathing and provocation tests helps identify triggers so a suitable treatment plan can be made. MedLuxLife organises testing and consultations at our partner hospital and supports families throughout the visit.

Treatments and services

Allergy skin tests

Skin testing to identify substances that may trigger allergic reactions.

Blood allergy tests

Laboratory tests to measure allergic sensitisation.

Lung function tests

Respiratory function testing for children with asthma, wheezing or chronic cough.

Provocation testing

Allergen provocation, food tests and anaesthetic drug tests carried out under medical supervision.

Allergy vaccination

Allergen immunotherapy may be offered where suitable.

Conditions treated

  • Asthma
  • Allergic bronchitis
  • Allergic rhinitis (hay fever)
  • Atopic dermatitis (eczema)
  • Urticaria (hives)
  • Food allergy

  • Chronic cough

  • Frequent respiratory tract infections
  • Allergic skin rashes

Before you travel

Children are more vulnerable to infections than other age groups, and some infections need specialist assessment and follow-up. This department diagnoses and treats infectious diseases in children, plans vaccinations and works with other paediatric specialties for a holistic approach. MedLuxLife arranges consultations at our partner hospital and supports families during their stay.

Treatments and services

Recurrent infections

Investigation of frequently recurring respiratory, gastrointestinal and urinary tract infections.

Childhood rash illnesses

Diagnosis and care for illnesses such as measles, rubella, fifth disease and sixth disease.

Immunocompromised children

Management of infections in children with cancer or after organ transplantation, including their vaccination planning.

Vaccination and prevention

Planning of required vaccines, management of vaccination programmes and advice on preventing infections.

Rarer infections

Follow-up of conditions such as tuberculosis and HIV infection in children.

Collaborative care

Close cooperation with paediatric intensive care, neurology, cardiology and gastroenterology.

Conditions treated

  • Respiratory tract infections
  • Acute gastroenteritis
  • Urinary tract infections
  • Recurrent infections
  • Measles
  • Rubella
  • Fifth disease
  • Sixth disease
  • Infections in immunocompromised children
  • Tuberculosis
  • HIV infection

Before you travel

  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports

Paediatric endocrinology covers hormonal, growth and metabolic disorders in children from the newborn period to 18 years. Treatment is planned with each child's growth and stage of development in mind. MedLuxLife coordinates consultations, tests and follow-up appointments with specialists at our partner hospital.

Treatments and services

Growth and development

Assessment of growth delay, short stature and developmental concerns.

Puberty disorders

Evaluation of early or delayed puberty and menstrual irregularities.

Diabetes and obesity

Diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of childhood diabetes, obesity and low blood sugar.

Thyroid, adrenal and pituitary

Care for disorders of the thyroid, adrenal and pituitary glands.

Bone and calcium metabolism

Investigation of calcium and bone metabolism disorders.

Sexual development

Evaluation of differences of sex development, including undescended testis and micropenis.

Conditions treated

  • Growth and development delays
  • Short stature
  • Delayed puberty
  • Early puberty
  • Diabetes
  • Obesity
  • Goitre
  • Hypothyroidism
  • Hyperthyroidism
  • Congenital adrenal hyperplasia
  • Adrenal insufficiency
  • Cushing syndrome
  • Excessive hair growth (hirsutism)
  • Menstrual irregularity
  • Turner syndrome
  • Calcium and bone metabolism disorders
  • Pituitary gland diseases
  • Hypoglycaemia
  • Micropenis
  • Undescended testis
  • Ambiguous genitalia

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Growth chart with height and weight records

Paediatric neurology diagnoses and treats disorders of the brain, spinal cord, nerves and muscles in children from birth to 18 years. Early assessment can be important for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning, supported by tests such as MRI and EEG where needed. MedLuxLife coordinates consultations, investigations and follow-up at our partner hospital.

Treatments and services

Clinical evaluation

A detailed neurological examination by a paediatric neurologist, with MRI and EEG when considered necessary.

Epilepsy and seizures

Monitoring and treatment of different seizure types and epilepsy in children.

Developmental delay

Assessment of delays in motor skills such as walking, in speech and in cognitive development.

Neuromuscular diseases

Care for muscle weakness, movement disorders and spinal muscular atrophy (SMA).

Genetic and metabolic disorders

Management of inherited and congenital conditions affecting the nervous system.

Headaches and fainting

Evaluation of headaches and fainting episodes in children.

Conditions treated

  • Simple fainting spells
  • Seizures
  • Epilepsy
  • Developmental delay (motor, speech and cognitive)
  • Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA)
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Down syndrome
  • Neuromuscular diseases
  • Genetic and metabolic diseases
  • Genetically inherited neurological diseases
  • Congenital diseases of the nervous system
  • Headaches in children

Before you travel

Paediatric nephrology deals with diseases of the kidneys, urinary tract, bladder and urethra in children from birth to 18 years. Signs such as swelling of the hands, feet or eyes, blood in the urine or pain when passing urine should be assessed without delay. MedLuxLife arranges specialist consultations at our partner hospital, where care is multidisciplinary and families are supported at every stage.

Treatments and services

Kidney failure

Diagnosis and management of acute and chronic kidney failure in children.

Dialysis in children

Dialysis care for children who need kidney replacement therapy.

Kidney transplantation

Care for children before and after kidney transplantation.

Urinary tract infections and reflux

Evaluation and treatment of urinary tract infections and vesicoureteral reflux.

Congenital anomalies

Follow-up of antenatal hydronephrosis and abnormalities of the urinary system.

Bedwetting and kidney stones

Assessment and treatment of enuresis and kidney stone disease in children.

Conditions treated

  • Acute kidney failure
  • Antenatal hydronephrosis
  • Other kidney diseases in children
  • Kidney transplantation
  • Dialysis
  • Enuresis (urinary incontinence)

Stem cell (bone marrow) transplantation is a treatment option for a range of hereditary and acquired diseases in children when other treatments are not sufficient. It is carried out by a specialised team in dedicated transplant units with strict infection control. MedLuxLife helps families with the assessment, planning and long stay that transplantation involves at our partner hospital.

Treatments and services

Stem cell transplantation

A specialised treatment for selected children whose condition has not responded adequately to medical therapy.

Pre- and post-transplant treatment

Intensive therapy before and after the transplant, with close monitoring of the weakened immune system.

Protected transplant unit

Single isolation rooms, filtered air, controlled access and strict hygiene rules help protect children from infection.

Intensive care setting

The transplant unit operates with intensive care standards throughout the treatment period.

Conditions that may be treated with transplantation

  • Leukaemias
  • Blood production disorders
  • Thalassaemia (Mediterranean anaemia)
  • Sickle cell disease
  • Bone marrow failure
  • Genetic disorders
  • Immune system diseases
  • Tumours

Paediatric cardiology looks after the heart and circulation of children from birth through adolescence. Specialists assess congenital and acquired heart conditions and plan treatment together with paediatric heart surgeons and other specialties. MedLuxLife arranges examinations and follow-up at our partner hospital and supports families during every visit.

Treatments and services

Specialist examination

Every assessment starts with a thorough examination by a paediatric cardiologist.

Echocardiography and ECG

Heart ultrasound, electrocardiogram and other tests help establish the diagnosis.

Follow-up of prenatal findings

Heart findings detected before birth by obstetricians are evaluated by paediatric cardiologists after delivery.

Individual treatment plans

A treatment plan is prepared for each child, with regular monitoring of how treatment is progressing.

Lifelong follow-up

Some children need regular cardiac check-ups over many years, so close contact with the care team is maintained.

Interdisciplinary care

Collaboration with paediatric cardiac surgery, paediatric haematology and oncology, genetics and other paediatric specialties.

Conditions assessed

  • Congenital heart disease
  • Acquired heart disease
  • Heart rhythm disturbances
  • Heart valve abnormalities
  • Other circulatory system problems

Paediatric oncology focuses on the diagnosis, treatment and long-term follow-up of cancers in children and adolescents up to the age of 18, including solid tumours, lymphomas and leukaemias. Childhood cancers behave differently from adult cancers and call for care designed around young patients and their families. MedLuxLife coordinates assessments and treatment at our partner hospital, helping families with records, appointments, travel and communication throughout the course of care.

Treatments and services

Diagnosis and staging

Thorough evaluation of suspected childhood tumours, lymphomas and leukaemias to establish the diagnosis and the extent of the disease.

Surgery

Surgical removal of tumours may form part of the treatment plan, depending on tumour type and spread.

Chemotherapy

Drug-based cancer treatment planned individually for each child, delivered on an inpatient or outpatient basis.

Radiotherapy

Radiation treatment may be recommended for certain tumour types as part of a combined plan.

Immunotherapy

Treatments that engage the immune system can be considered for selected childhood cancers.

Stem cell transplantation

Stem cell transplantation is among the treatment options for some childhood cancers and blood diseases.

Paediatric haematology-oncology clinic

Outpatient and inpatient care in a dedicated paediatric haematology-oncology clinic, with single rooms that allow a parent to stay with the child during monitoring and treatment.

Outpatient chemotherapy unit

A day unit for short treatments and blood transfusions, so that many children can return home the same day.

Dedicated children's outpatient floor

Outpatient consultations take place on a separate floor reserved for children with cancer, leukaemia and blood diseases.

Long-term follow-up

Structured follow-up after treatment to monitor recovery and the child's ongoing health.

Childhood tumours evaluated

  • Brain tumours
  • Wilms' tumour and other kidney tumours
  • Neuroblastoma and ganglioneuroblastoma (adrenal tumours)
  • Soft tissue sarcomas (muscle and connective tissue tumours)
  • Bone tumours
  • Retinoblastoma (eye tumour)
  • Germ cell tumours
  • Hepatoblastoma and hepatocellular carcinoma (liver tumours)
  • Lymphomas
  • Leukaemias
  • Other rare childhood tumours

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Pathology and biopsy reports
  • Previous imaging (MRI, CT or PET-CT) on CD/DVD with reports

How MedLuxLife supports you

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

The paediatrics department provides diagnosis and treatment for children from birth to 18 years of age, with outpatient clinics, an inpatient ward and intensive care areas designed for children. It is organised into a newborn section (0-28 days) and a child section (0-18 years), with subspecialties working together as a multidisciplinary team. MedLuxLife helps families access the right paediatric specialist at our partner hospital and coordinates appointments, travel and communication.

Treatments and services

General paediatric care

Outpatient, inpatient and intensive care services for children aged 0-18 in child-friendly settings.

Newborn care

The neonatal section serves babies up to 28 days old through a neonatal unit, a neonatal observation unit and a neonatal intensive care unit.

Breastfeeding support

The hospital follows the UNICEF and WHO Baby-Friendly approach, with specially trained staff helping mothers establish and maintain breastfeeding.

Paediatric allergy

Testing and treatment for allergic diseases, including skin tests, blood allergy tests, lung function tests, allergen provocation tests, food tests, anaesthetic drug tests and allergy vaccination (immunotherapy).

Paediatric endocrinology

Assessment of hormonal and metabolic problems such as growth disorders, diabetes, thyroid and puberty-related conditions.

Paediatric haematology-oncology

Diagnosis and treatment of blood diseases and childhood cancers, with outpatient and inpatient care in a paediatric bone marrow transplantation clinic.

Paediatric gastroenterology, hepatology and nutrition

Care for diseases of the oesophagus, stomach, duodenum, small and large intestine, liver and gallbladder, as well as nutritional disorders.

Paediatric surgery

Treatment of urological, genital, digestive and respiratory conditions and newborn anomalies, including non-cardiac thoracic, oncological, digestive and endocrine surgery, paediatric gynaecology, trauma surgery, diagnostic and interventional endoscopy, and laparoscopic and thoracoscopic procedures.

Paediatric nephrology

Diagnosis and treatment of congenital and acquired problems of the kidneys, urinary tract, bladder and urethra.

Paediatric rheumatology

Outpatient care for childhood rheumatic diseases affecting joints, muscles, blood vessels and skin.

Conditions treated

  • Asthma
  • Allergic bronchitis
  • Allergic rhinitis (hay fever)
  • Atopic dermatitis (eczema)
  • Urticaria (hives)
  • Food allergy
  • Drug allergy, including allergy to anaesthetic agents
  • Chronic cough
  • Wheezing in infants
  • Frequent respiratory tract infections
  • Allergic skin rashes
  • Growth retardation and short stature
  • Type 1 diabetes mellitus
  • Hypoglycaemia
  • Early or delayed puberty
  • Thyroid diseases (hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism)
  • Pituitary gland diseases
  • Menstrual irregularities
  • Excessive hair growth
  • Disorders of sexual development
  • Adrenal gland diseases
  • Obesity
  • Leukaemia
  • Blood production disorders
  • Thalassaemia (Mediterranean anaemia)
  • Sickle cell disease
  • Bone marrow failure
  • Genetic diseases
  • Immune system diseases
  • Childhood tumours
  • Diseases of the oesophagus, stomach and intestines
  • Liver and gallbladder diseases
  • Nutritional disorders
  • Kidney and urinary tract disorders
  • Childhood rheumatic diseases

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Child's vaccination record
  • Growth charts or previous paediatric reports

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Treatment is tailored to the child's age and development, with open, endoscopic and laparoscopic techniques available. MedLuxLife coordinates consultations, surgery dates and aftercare at our partner hospital, so that families can focus on their child.

Prenatal consultation

Open, endoscopic and laparoscopic techniques

Day surgery

Pain management

Specific pain-relief measures aim to keep children comfortable in hospital and after returning home.

Paediatric urology

In collaboration with the Urology department, surgical and endoscopic treatment of congenital anomalies and acquired problems such as stones and trauma.

Work with other specialties for conditions such as congenital spinal cord defects and nocturnal enuresis (bedwetting).

Paediatric urology conditions

Dermatology covers the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of conditions affecting the skin, hair and nails. Alongside medical dermatology, the department at our partner hospital offers dermatosurgery, cosmetic dermatology and care for certain genital skin conditions. MedLuxLife arranges consultations and helps combine dermatology appointments with any other treatment you are planning during your stay.

Treatments and services

Medical dermatology

Diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of a wide range of skin, hair and nail diseases.

Dermatosurgery

Surgical procedures on the skin, for example for moles or skin lesions that need removal or examination.

Cosmetic dermatology

Dermatocosmetic procedures including laser applications, botulinum toxin (Botox) and chemical peels.

Genital skin conditions

Diagnosis and treatment of genital warts, molluscum, genital herpes, external genital fungal infections and syphilis.

Skin cancer and mole assessment

Examination of moles and suspicious lesions, and treatment planning for skin cancers.

Conditions treated

  • Acne
  • Psoriasis
  • Eczema
  • Skin allergies

Balanced nutrition plays an important part in both preventing illness and supporting medical treatment. The nutrition and dietetics team at our partner hospital assesses your eating habits and body composition and develops a personalised nutrition plan with regular follow-up. MedLuxLife coordinates your consultations and can combine them with other treatments during your stay.

Treatments and services

Initial assessment and body analysis

Review of eating habits plus body analysis to measure fat, muscle and water percentages and regional fat distribution.

Personalised nutrition therapy

A plan based on age, height, sex, physical activity and blood test results, with regular follow-up appointments.

Inpatient nutrition

Menus for hospitalised patients are planned together with doctors, the patient and relatives, and monitored from preparation to delivery.

Home nutrition education

Guidance during the hospital stay on how to continue the nutrition plan at home.

Support around obesity surgery

Nutritional preparation before bariatric surgery to help reduce surgical risk, and guidance on sustainable lifestyle changes afterwards.

Home-based monitoring

On request, follow-up at home for elderly or bedridden patients.

Corporate services

Nutrition and diet counselling and customised menu planning for private organisations.

Education and awareness

Seminars, training sessions and media work to raise awareness of healthy eating.

Areas of medical nutrition

  • Medical nutrition in obesity
  • Medical nutrition in diabetes mellitus
  • Medical nutrition in liver diseases
  • Medical nutrition in kidney diseases
  • Medical nutrition in high blood pressure and cardiovascular diseases
  • Medical nutrition for rheumatism and gout
  • Medical nutrition for oncology patients
  • Malnutrition (extreme thinness and inadequate nutrition)
  • Nutrition with food allergies and food intolerances
  • Healthy nutrition in infancy, childhood and adolescence
  • Healthy nutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding
  • Sports nutrition

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports

  • A short food diary of a typical week

Chest diseases, or pulmonology, covers the diagnosis, treatment and long-term follow-up of conditions affecting the lungs and airways. The department at our partner hospital serves adult patients through its outpatient clinic, bronchoscopy unit, pulmonary function laboratory and allergy skin testing. MedLuxLife coordinates appointments and ensures that your previous scans and lung function results reach the specialist before you arrive.

Treatments and services

Outpatient clinic

Assessment, diagnosis and individual treatment planning for adults with respiratory symptoms or known lung disease.

Bronchoscopy unit

Examination of the airways with a flexible camera to support diagnosis and, where needed, treatment.

Pulmonary function laboratory

Breathing tests that measure how well the lungs are working.

Allergy skin testing

Skin tests that can help identify allergic triggers for respiratory symptoms.

Smoking cessation support

Counselling and follow-up for people who want to stop smoking.

Respiratory physiotherapy

Breathing physiotherapy for hospitalised patients.

Medical treatment and follow-up

Ongoing physician follow-up and adjustment of treatment for chronic lung conditions.

Conditions treated

  • Asthma
  • Chronic bronchitis
  • COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease)
  • Other smoking-related lung diseases
  • Lung cancer
  • Pneumonia
  • Tuberculosis
  • Interstitial lung diseases, including sarcoidosis
  • Drug-induced lung problems
  • Lung disease caused by occupational exposure

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Chest X-ray or CT images with reports
  • Previous lung function (spirometry) results

This department diagnoses, treats and follows up infections caused by bacteria, viruses, fungi and parasites, using up-to-date laboratory and, where needed, molecular methods. It also advises on vaccination, prevention and travel medicine. MedLuxLife arranges outpatient or inpatient care at our partner hospital and handles the practical details so you can focus on recovery.

Treatments and services

Outpatient and inpatient care

Diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases in the outpatient clinic or on the ward, depending on the patient's condition.

Laboratory and molecular diagnostics

Advanced laboratory techniques and molecular methods are used when needed to plan the diagnostic process.

Vaccination advice

Guidance on vaccines that can help protect against infectious diseases.

Prevention

Advice on practical methods to reduce the risk of infection.

Travel medicine

Consultation before or after travel on infections, vaccines and precautions relevant to your destination.

Infection control

A hospital infection control committee oversees hygiene, with up-to-date air and surface disinfection and dedicated bed-cleaning systems to help reduce hospital-acquired infections.

Conditions treated

  • Illnesses accompanied by fever
  • Common cold
  • Flu
  • Jaundice (hepatitis A, hepatitis B, hepatitis C and others)
  • HIV/AIDS and other viral diseases
  • Rash illnesses
  • Diarrhoea
  • Food poisoning
  • Parasitic diseases
  • Systemic fungal infections
  • Meningitis

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Recent microbiology, culture or serology results
  • Vaccination record and recent travel history

Immunology deals with diseases of the immune system, which can be difficult to recognise because symptoms are not always obvious. Specialists at our partner hospital combine careful clinical evaluation with an advanced laboratory to reach a diagnosis and design a personal treatment plan. MedLuxLife coordinates your tests and consultations and helps you take the results and recommendations home with you.

Treatments and services

Diagnosis of immune system diseases

A thorough evaluation supported by blood tests, immunophenotyping, tissue typing, antibody profiles, allergy tests and other laboratory methods.

Personalised treatment

Treatment is tailored to each patient and may include medication and immunoglobulin therapy, aiming to ease symptoms and slow disease progression.

Lifestyle counselling

Advice on nutrition, exercise and sleep for patients with weakened immunity, provided together with other units of the hospital.

Vaccination and prevention

Vaccines and preventive measures recommended for people who are prone to immune system disorders, to help lower the risk of infection.

Laboratory tests

  • Blood tests
  • Immunophenotypic analyses
  • Tissue typing tests
  • Antibody profiles
  • Allergy tests

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results

  • Previous immunology and allergy test results

Gastroenterology covers the evaluation, diagnosis and treatment of diseases of the stomach, intestines, liver, bile ducts and pancreas. The department at our partner hospital offers a wide range of diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy, alongside dedicated care for reflux, liver disease, inflammatory bowel disease and colorectal cancer screening. MedLuxLife helps you arrange procedures, understand preparation instructions and receive your reports in a form your home doctor can use.

Treatments and services

Diagnostic endoscopy

Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy, colonoscopy and double-balloon endoscopy (enteroscopy), which can examine parts of the small intestine beyond the reach of standard scopes, for example in unexplained bleeding, iron-deficiency anaemia or suspected Crohn's disease.

Endoscopic treatment of bleeding

Band ligation, sclerotherapy, haemoclips and argon laser treatment for bleeding from the stomach or intestines.

Treatment of narrowing

Balloon dilatation and stent placement for strictures of the stomach or intestines.

Endoscopic obesity treatment

Intragastric balloon placement during upper endoscopy, which may support weight loss alongside lifestyle changes; the balloon is removed after a set period.

Reflux diagnosis and treatment

Upper endoscopy, 24-hour pH monitoring and motility studies, followed by medication, endoscopic options such as the Stretta procedure and endoscopic fundoplication (for example Plicator or Gastrofix), or surgery.

Helicobacter pylori testing

Urea breath test and stool antigen testing to diagnose H. pylori infection and guide treatment.

Colorectal cancer screening

Screening colonoscopy with polypectomy, as polyps can be found and removed during the procedure; people at higher risk receive an individual screening plan.

ERCP

Endoscopic imaging of the bile and pancreatic ducts, which also allows stone removal, stent placement to relieve blockages and biopsy.

Haemorrhoid treatment

Medication for early stages and band ligation, sclerotherapy, laser or infrared treatment during sedated colonoscopy for intermediate stages, with referral for surgery in advanced cases.

Hepatology unit

Diagnosis and long-term follow-up of chronic hepatitis B and C using liver function tests, HBV and HCV PCR, abdominal ultrasound and liver biopsy, with antiviral treatment options including interferon.

Inflammatory bowel disease

Diagnosis of ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease by colonoscopy and/or double-balloon enteroscopy, and ongoing medical treatment.

  • Colonoscopy
  • Double-balloon endoscopy (enteroscopy)

Nephrology is the branch of internal medicine concerned with kidney health and disease, including blood pressure, fluid and electrolyte balance, and the effects of other illnesses and medicines on the kidneys. At our partner hospital, nephrologists provide outpatient, inpatient and intensive care services, all forms of dialysis and assessment for kidney transplantation with lifelong follow-up. MedLuxLife coordinates your appointments and treatment schedule and organises the practical details of your stay.

Treatments and services

Outpatient clinic

Diagnosis and treatment of kidney diseases, preventive care for people at higher risk such as those with diabetes or hypertension, and supportive care for advanced kidney disease.

Inpatient care and consultations

Ward-based care and follow-up, plus nephrology consultations for other departments.

Kidney effects of other conditions and medicines

Evaluation of how diabetes, hypertension, rheumatological disease, acute illness or long-term medicines such as chemotherapy, anti-rheumatic drugs and cortisone may affect the kidneys.

Intensive care kidney support

Haemodialysis, haemofiltration, haemodiafiltration and continuous venovenous haemofiltration for patients with acute kidney failure.

Haemoperfusion and plasmapheresis

Blood purification treatments that may be used when clinically indicated.

Haemodialysis

Acute or chronic haemodialysis, with session frequency and length adjusted to remaining kidney function and diet.

Peritoneal dialysis

Peritoneal dialysis including continuous ambulatory peritoneal dialysis (CAPD), which patients perform themselves at home.

Kidney transplantation

Assessment for transplantation in end-stage kidney disease, with transplantation through the organ transplant unit and lifelong post-transplant follow-up.

Conditions treated

  • Structural and functional disorders of the urinary system
  • Hereditary kidney diseases
  • Polycystic kidney disease
  • Familial Mediterranean fever
  • Amyloidosis
  • Kidney stone disease
  • Fluid, electrolyte and acid-base disorders
  • Hypertension and hypertensive kidney disease
  • Kidney and urinary tract infections
  • Diabetes-related kidney disease
  • Kidney involvement in rheumatological diseases
  • Kidney problems related to fluid loss, heart failure or sepsis
  • Medication-related kidney damage
  • Acute kidney failure
  • End-stage kidney disease

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Recent kidney function and urine test results
  • Dialysis prescription and session records, if on dialysis

Pituitary disorders can be difficult to recognise because their symptoms often resemble other illnesses, so early and accurate diagnosis matters. This dedicated clinic brings several specialties together to evaluate pituitary diseases and tumours and to plan diagnosis and treatment using modern imaging, laboratory and treatment methods. MedLuxLife coordinates your referral, records and appointments at our partner hospital.

Treatments and services

Early diagnosis

Focused assessment of symptoms, hormone levels and imaging to identify pituitary conditions as early as possible.

Pituitary tumour care

Evaluation and treatment planning for pituitary tumours and other diseases of the gland.

Multidisciplinary team

Care involves endocrinologists specialised in pituitary disease, neurosurgeons, neuroradiologists, neuropathologists, neuro-ophthalmologists, radiation oncologists, anaesthesiologists and supporting health staff.

Weekly case conferences

Pituitary cases are discussed at regular multidisciplinary meetings, which external physicians can also attend with their own cases.

Education programmes

The clinic runs educational programmes on pituitary disease for patients and physicians.

International collaboration

The clinic works together with international organisations in the field of pituitary disease.

Before you travel

Endocrinology deals with the hormone-producing glands and the metabolic conditions they influence, such as diabetes, thyroid disorders and diseases of the pituitary and adrenal glands. Most of these conditions are diagnosed with blood tests and imaging and treated with medication and lifestyle measures, with long-term follow-up. MedLuxLife arranges a consultation with an endocrinologist at our partner hospital and coordinates any further tests or treatment.

For surgical treatment of the thyroid, parathyroid and adrenal glands, see Endocrine Surgery and the Thyroid and Parathyroid Clinic.

Treatments and services

Diabetes

Diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of type 1 and type 2 diabetes, including insulin therapy, modern oral and injectable medicines and screening for complications.

Thyroid disorders

Treatment of an underactive or overactive thyroid (hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism), Hashimoto's and Graves' disease, and assessment of thyroid nodules.

Pituitary diseases

Diagnosis and treatment of pituitary tumours and hormone imbalances, in cooperation with the pituitary clinic and neurosurgery.

Adrenal diseases

Assessment of adrenal gland disorders such as Cushing's syndrome, Addison's disease, hyperaldosteronism and adrenal masses.

Calcium, bone and parathyroid

Diagnosis and treatment of osteoporosis, vitamin D deficiency and parathyroid hormone disorders.

Obesity and metabolic syndrome

Medical assessment of weight-related metabolic problems, insulin resistance and metabolic syndrome, with referral to nutrition or obesity surgery where suitable.

Lipid disorders

Diagnosis and treatment of high cholesterol and triglyceride levels to reduce cardiovascular risk.

Reproductive hormones

Hormonal causes of irregular periods, hirsutism, PCOS, low testosterone and menopause-related complaints.

Tests and examinations

  • Hormone blood tests
  • Dynamic hormone stimulation and suppression tests
  • Oral glucose tolerance test and HbA1c
  • Thyroid ultrasound
  • Fine-needle aspiration biopsy of thyroid nodules
  • Bone density measurement (DEXA)
  • Imaging of the pituitary and adrenal glands in cooperation with radiology

Before you travel

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results

  • Recent hormone test results (for example thyroid tests, HbA1c)
  • Your current insulin or hormone doses

title.rendered: Thyroid and Parathyroid Diseases and Surgery Clinic

content.raw:
This multidisciplinary clinic is dedicated exclusively to diseases of the thyroid and parathyroid glands, offering early diagnosis together with medical and surgical treatment. Specialists from seven fields evaluate each case jointly, following current scientific evidence. MedLuxLife coordinates your assessment, tests and any surgery at our partner hospital, with clear communication at every stage.

Treatments and services

Multidisciplinary team

Specialists in endocrine surgery, endocrinology, nuclear medicine, radiology, pathology, genetics and bioengineering work together on each case.

Thyroid and parathyroid ultrasound

Dedicated ultrasound examination of the thyroid and parathyroid glands.

Scintigraphy

Thyroid (Tc99m), parathyroid (MIBI) and DOTATATE scintigraphy to assess gland function and locate abnormal tissue.

Choline PET

PET imaging that can help locate parathyroid tissue when other tests are inconclusive.

Function tests

Laboratory testing of thyroid and parathyroid hormone function.

Biopsy

Fine needle and Tru-Cut biopsy to examine nodules and suspicious tissue.

Radioactive iodine therapy

Radioactive iodine treatment for suitable thyroid conditions.

Lithium-supported radioactive iodine therapy

In selected cases, lithium may be used alongside radioactive iodine to support the treatment.

Radiofrequency ablation

Non-surgical treatment of thyroid nodules using radiofrequency energy.

Thyroid and parathyroid surgery

Operations using classical and microsurgical techniques, as well as the scarless transoral approach (TOETVA).

Parathyroid transplantation

Reimplantation of parathyroid tissue to help preserve gland function where needed.

Diagnostic and treatment techniques

  • Specific thyroid and parathyroid ultrasonography
  • Thyroid (Tc99m) and parathyroid (MIBI) scintigraphy
  • Thyroid and parathyroid function tests
  • DOTATATE scintigraphy
  • Fine needle and Tru-Cut biopsy
  • Choline PET
  • Radioactive iodine therapy
  • Lithium-supported radioactive iodine therapy
  • Parathyroid transplantation
  • Radiofrequency ablation of nodules (non-surgical)
  • Surgery with classical and microsurgical techniques
  • Scarless surgery (TOETVA technique)

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Previous thyroid ultrasound and scintigraphy reports
  • Recent thyroid and parathyroid hormone and calcium results

PET imaging that can help locate parathyroid tissue when other tests are inconclusive.

Function tests

Laboratory testing of thyroid and parathyroid hormone function.

Biopsy

Fine needle and Tru-Cut biopsy to examine nodules and suspicious tissue.

Radioactive iodine therapy

Radioactive iodine treatment for suitable thyroid conditions.

Lithium-supported radioactive iodine therapy

In selected cases, lithium may be used alongside radioactive iodine to support the treatment.

Radiofrequency ablation

Non-surgical treatment of thyroid nodules using radiofrequency energy.

Thyroid and parathyroid surgery

Operations using classical and microsurgical techniques, as well as the scarless transoral approach (TOETVA).

Parathyroid transplantation

Reimplantation of parathyroid tissue to help preserve gland function where needed.

Endocrine surgery treats disorders of the hormone-producing glands, mainly the thyroid, parathyroid and adrenal glands, when too much or too little hormone is produced or when a growth needs removal. These delicate operations require careful technique to protect the voice, calcium balance and surrounding structures. MedLuxLife helps you share your hormone results and scans with the surgical team at our partner hospital and plan your stay around surgery and recovery.

Treatments and services

Thyroidectomy

Removal of the whole thyroid gland or one of its lobes, for example for nodules, goitre, overactivity or cancer.

Parathyroidectomy

Removal of one or more of the four parathyroid glands, which regulate calcium and phosphorus levels.

Parathyroid transplantation

Reimplantation of parathyroid tissue, which may be performed to preserve calcium regulation.

Adrenalectomy

Removal of one or both adrenal glands, which produce cortisol and hormones involved in blood pressure control and development.

Pancreatectomy

Removal of part or all of the pancreas, for example for neuroendocrine tumours.

Specialised surgical expertise

Operations are carried out by surgeons with additional experience in endocrine surgery, with a focus on careful, precise technique.

Conditions treated surgically

  • Adrenal tumours
  • Cushing's syndrome
  • Parathyroid gland disorders
  • Parathyroid adenomas
  • Parathyroid cancer
  • Hyperparathyroidism
  • Hyperthyroidism
  • Goitre
  • Graves' disease
  • Toxic (hyperfunctioning) thyroid nodules
  • Thyroid nodules
  • Thyroid cancer
  • Neuroendocrine tumours

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Thyroid, parathyroid or adrenal hormone and calcium blood test results
  • Neck ultrasound, scintigraphy or CT/MRI reports, and any fine-needle biopsy results

Thoracic surgery treats diseases of the organs and tissues within the chest, excluding the heart, including the lungs, airways, chest wall, pleura, diaphragm, mediastinum and oesophagus. The department uses fibreoptic and endoscopic equipment, minimally invasive surgical tools and imaging from virtual bronchoscopy to PET-CT, supported by pathology and laboratory services. MedLuxLife coordinates evaluation and surgery at our partner hospital, from sharing your scans to planning your recovery stay.

Treatments and services

Lung cancer surgery

Surgical treatment of lung cancer by open surgery or, in suitable cases, fully endoscopic techniques.

Lungs and main airways

Surgical and endoscopic procedures for diseases of the lungs and the major airways.

Airway stents and endoscopic airway opening

For patients who cannot undergo surgery, stents and endoscopic procedures may help relieve breathing symptoms.

Thoracic outlet syndrome

Surgical treatment for compression of nerves and blood vessels that can cause arm pain, coldness, numbness and weakness.

Chest wall diseases

Treatment of congenital and acquired conditions of the chest wall.

Pleura, diaphragm and chest cavity

Care for diseases of the lung lining, the diaphragm and the chest cavity.

Mediastinal surgery

Surgical procedures in the mediastinum, the central compartment of the chest.

Oesophageal surgery

Treatment of oesophageal motility disorders, benign and malignant tumours, hernias and reflux-related disease.

Advanced diagnostics

Imaging such as virtual bronchoscopy and PET-CT, together with pathology and laboratory support, to guide treatment decisions.

Audiology covers the detailed assessment and rehabilitation of hearing and balance problems in babies, children and adults. The department at our partner hospital offers a broad range of hearing and vestibular tests, including objective tests suitable for infants and for people with dizziness. MedLuxLife helps families schedule tests at suitable times, explains preparation requirements in advance and arranges for results to be shared with your doctors at home.

Treatments and services

Newborn hearing screening

Screening of babies' hearing using BERA so that possible hearing loss can be identified early.

Clinical BERA (ABR)

An objective electrophysiological test that measures the auditory nerve's response to sound through electrodes placed on the head, used especially for infants who did not pass screening, babies with risk factors and children with speech delay who cannot complete other tests. It is also known as ABR, BAEP or BAER.

Clinical otoacoustic emissions and ASSR

TEOAE/DPOAE and auditory steady-state response testing, which can support and complement BERA findings.

Child audiometry

Age-appropriate hearing tests including behavioural observation audiometry, visual reinforcement audiometry and play audiometry, as well as free field testing.

Adult hearing evaluation

Pure-tone and speech audiometry, plus high-frequency audiometry where indicated.

Middle ear and Eustachian tube tests

Tympanometry and acoustic reflex testing, high-frequency (1000 Hz) tympanometry for babies up to six months, and Eustachian tube function testing.

Videonystagmography (VNG)

Records eye movements with video goggles during oculomotor, positional and caloric tests to help determine whether dizziness originates in the inner ear or the brain.

Video head impulse test (vHIT)

Assesses the vestibulo-ocular reflex of each semicircular canal separately.

VEMP test

Vestibular evoked myogenic potentials, used in the differential diagnosis of conditions such as semicircular canal dehiscence, early Meniere's disease and otolith organ dysfunction.

Caloric and rotational testing

Caloric vestibular testing (ENG) and rotational examination to evaluate the function of each balance organ and central compensation.

Repositioning manoeuvres for BPPV

Audiology covers the detailed assessment and rehabilitation of hearing and balance problems in babies, children and adults. The department at our partner hospital offers a broad range of hearing and vestibular tests, including objective tests suitable for infants and for people with dizziness. MedLuxLife helps families schedule tests at suitable times, explains preparation requirements in advance and arranges for results to be shared with your doctors at home.

Treatments and services

Newborn hearing screening

Screening of babies’ hearing using BERA so that possible hearing loss can be identified early.

Clinical BERA (ABR)

An objective electrophysiological test that measures the auditory nerve’s response to sound through electrodes placed on the head, used especially for infants who did not pass screening, babies with risk factors and children with speech delay who cannot complete other tests. It is also known as ABR, BAEP or BAER.

Clinical otoacoustic emissions and ASSR

TEOAE/DPOAE and auditory steady-state response testing, which can support and complement BERA findings.

Child audiometry

Age-appropriate hearing tests including behavioural observation audiometry, visual reinforcement audiometry and play audiometry, as well as free field testing.

Adult hearing evaluation

Pure-tone and speech audiometry, plus high-frequency audiometry where indicated.

Middle ear and Eustachian tube tests

Tympanometry and acoustic reflex testing, high-frequency (1000 Hz) tympanometry for babies up to six months, and Eustachian tube function testing.

Videonystagmography (VNG)

Records eye movements with video goggles during oculomotor, positional and caloric tests to help determine whether dizziness originates in the inner ear or the brain.

Video head impulse test (vHIT)

Assesses the vestibulo-ocular reflex of each semicircular canal separately.

VEMP test

Vestibular evoked myogenic potentials, used in the differential diagnosis of conditions such as semicircular canal dehiscence, early Meniere’s disease and otolith organ dysfunction.

Caloric and rotational testing

Caloric vestibular testing (ENG) and rotational examination to evaluate the function of each balance organ and central compensation.

Minimally invasive keyhole techniques applied across a wide range of general surgical procedures.

Breast surgery deals with the surgical treatment of breast diseases, most notably breast cancer, where early diagnosis can make a meaningful difference to treatment options. At our partner hospital, breast surgeons work alongside medical oncology, plastic surgery, radiology and pathology so that each plan reflects the individual's diagnosis and preferences. MedLuxLife helps you gather your imaging and biopsy results and arranges a multidisciplinary opinion before any decision is made.

Treatments and services

Multidisciplinary breast care

Diagnosis and treatment planning involve breast surgery, medical oncology, plastic surgery, radiology, pathology and other specialists as needed.

Lumpectomy (breast-conserving surgery)

Removal of the tumour together with a small margin of surrounding healthy tissue, preserving the rest of the breast.

Total mastectomy

Removal of the entire breast, which may be considered in early- or later-stage breast cancer depending on the individual situation.

Nipple-sparing mastectomy

Removal of breast tissue while preserving the skin and nipple, usually combined with an implant to restore breast shape.

Prophylactic mastectomy

Preventive removal of breast tissue that may be discussed with people at high risk of breast cancer to help reduce that risk.

Individual choice of technique

The surgical approach is selected according to the stage of disease, the patient's condition and their wishes.

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Mammography, breast ultrasound and MRI images with reports
  • Biopsy and pathology reports, including receptor status if available
